root.label: CPSC publishes 12 product recalls on October 1

events.label: CPSC publishes 12 product recalls on October 1

slots.name: recall count
slots.sentence: Twelve new product recalls were published by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission on Thursday, Oct. 1, including a variety of household items and toys sold at popular retailers like Amazon, Target, The Home Depot and Dollar Tree.
